executiveSummary: Election-focused synthetic media remains the most consequential risk this cycle, with reports indicating AI-generated political ads and messaging are actively circulating in Michigan and testing new deepfake laws in Oregon. View Article View Article Research developments cut both ways: new work shows several neural audio watermarking schemes can be removed with training-free attacks, undermining reliance on watermark-only defenses, while concurrent efforts advance detection benchmarks and explainable fake-image forensics. Supporting Report Supporting Report On the defensive front, enterprises and platforms are moving toward real-time deepfake warnings for videoconferences and expanded provenance via watermarking and content credentials, including vendor responses aligned to EU requirements. View Article View Article Overall, the threat environment appears to be worsening: adversaries can degrade LLM-based bot detection, new content strategies can manipulate generative search outputs, and regulators and courts are still defining enforceable obligations for platforms. Layer provenance with detection: Analyst Recommendation - Treat watermarking/content credentials as advisory. Combine with robust detectors, human review, and out-of-band verification for high-stakes workflows.
Harden voice-workflows: Analyst Recommendation - Require step-up verification (callbacks, passphrases) for financial approvals; deploy liveness/anti-replay checks in contact centers.
Secure AI-agent testing: Analyst Recommendation - Isolate test environments, restrict egress, and monitor for autonomous outreach; pre-approve target domains and identities.
Platform moderation resilience: Analyst Recommendation - Use multi-LLM and non-LLM features (graph/behavioral signals) to mitigate adversarial evasion; red-team moderation pipelines regularly.
Election readiness: Analyst Recommendation - Stand up rapid content triage, legal counsel hotlines, and public debunk channels; coordinate with state officials and local media for timely corrections.
